notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[b]Add [/b]:
[list]
[*] Adding cardinal points to the map
[*] Dialogue from NPCs indicating the direction to follow to find the cousin
[*] The targeting point of enemy navigation is no longer the center of the player, but a target that rotates around.
[*] Added an explanatory screen on the use of combos and their triggering
[/list]

[b]Update[/b] :
[list]
[*] Increased writing speed.
[*] Small optimization on physics and collision management
[*] Street NPC sometimes indicates the direction of the cousin
[*] When yellow vest and red vest
[/list]

notes.title: June update
notes.content:
[h2]Fix :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Detection cousin on road or on pavement
[*] The skeleton follows the movement of the enemy alone if it is hostile
[*] Magnetization to the enemy's ground
[*] Rotation when one enemy chats with another
[*] Animation in the elevator could "shake"
[*] Sound of player footsteps
[/list]

[h2]Update :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Default keyboard input used QWERTY by default
[*] Optimization of the refresh of the mini map and the map. Optimization of enemy physics during movement or moments of inactivity. 
[*] Optimization of enemy spawn/de-spawn. 
[*] Level A1 added information on the first objectives.
[*] When Marianne fights NPCs cannot speak.
[*] NPCs no longer speak during combat
[*] NPCs can only be questioned once
[*] NPCs do not systematically give the same clues
[/list]

[h2]Clean :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Remove *.otf font file not used / screen resolution not effect / fix : lambert and jitter option
[*] Elevator signal not used
[/list]
